maturities.experimental: Implemented behind an explicit experimental boundary
maturities.agent_guided: Requires agent judgment and project context

resultStates.suspected: A lead that still needs context or reproduction.
resultStates.unknown: The check or evidence source was unavailable.
resultStates.not_applicable: Outside the recorded scope or absent from the project.

capabilities.name: Crawl-boundary audit
capabilities.scope: Checks robots, sitemap, crawler accessibility, soft-404 behavior and optional authorized sensitive-path probes.

capabilities.name: Crawler identity verification
capabilities.scope: Verifies an exact crawler product through published ranges or matching forward-confirmed reverse DNS; a user-agent string is never sufficient.

capabilities.name: Edge hardening verification
capabilities.scope: Checks security headers, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, certificate validation and TLS policy; bounded rate-limit traffic is separately authorized.

capabilities.name: Narrow deterministic source audit
capabilities.scope: Runs 20 stable built-in risk rules and 2 evidence-integrity rules: four shared configuration checks plus eight bounded JavaScript/TypeScript and eight bounded Python leads. Syntax matches remain suspected and this is not whole-program SAST.

capabilities.name: AWS exposure inventory helper
capabilities.scope: Runs a read-only, permission-aware AWS inventory helper. Denied, missing or malformed evidence becomes explicit v2 unknown coverage and never a fabricated posture finding.

capabilities.name: Gitleaks secret detection adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Gitleaks 8.30.1 adapter for Git history and working-tree secret-pattern leads. Matches remain suspected until credential validity/exposure is established; evidence persists rule/location and digested fingerprints, never secret values.

capabilities.name: OSV-Scanner dependency vulnerability adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in OSV-Scanner 2.5.0 adapter for recorded lockfile advisory matches. Matches remain suspected until project impact is established; evidence preserves advisory identity and upstream severity without local inflation.

capabilities.name: Opengrep source data-flow adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Opengrep 1.27.0 adapter with two project-owned, digest-pinned same-file request-to-command taint rules for JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. It is not a general rules catalogue or whole-program SAST; every match remains suspected.

capabilities.name: Bounded Checkov deployment-policy adapter
capabilities.scope: Opt-in Checkov 3.3.9 adapter limited to CKV_DOCKER_8 and CKV_DOCKER_2 on the root Dockerfile plus CKV2_GHA_1 on root .github/workflows YAML. Matches remain suspected deployment-policy leads. Compose, Terraform, Kubernetes and the rest of Checkov are not stable coverage.

capabilities.name: Local before/after demo
capabilities.scope: Runs the real crawl audit against an intentionally misconfigured local fixture, records JSON/Markdown evidence and a fixture patch, then retests.

capabilities.name: Automatic project discovery and scoped run
capabilities.scope: Detects supported Node/Python and split-stack projects, package managers, lockfiles and config/deployment paths, then creates a versioned network-free security scope. It never establishes deployment ownership.

capabilities.name: Stable multi-format finding reports
capabilities.scope: Renders source v3 and crawl, demo, crawler-identity, edge and AWS v2 conclusions as JSON, Markdown, escaped HTML, SARIF 2.1.0 and JUnit while preserving domain, evidence state, baseline state and fingerprints. Legacy v1 remains historical input only.

capabilities.name: Patch and baseline retest evidence loop
capabilities.scope: Writes patch-only proposals, explains source findings and compares persisted v2 or v3 baselines with subject/scope/rule identity, per-rule coverage and honest new/fixed/unchanged/regressed/unretested/not_comparable states.

capabilities.name: Professional and plain-language finding explanation
capabilities.scope: Source report v3 gives every finding a technical term, ordinary-language meaning, realistic consequence, evidence boundary, reviewable proposal, alternatives, side effects, required decisions, separate security and functional retests, and rollback criteria. Default display omits raw evidence; the technical view is explicit.

capabilities.name: Installer and GitHub Action
capabilities.scope: Installs Claude Code, Codex and CLI surfaces with conflict preflight/backups, and runs a composite Action with backward-compatible crawl mode plus built-in or caller-provided source adapters.

capabilities.name: Frontend exposure review
capabilities.scope: Guides source/build-artifact review for secrets, source maps, endpoints, client-side trust and CSP. It is not a general automatic frontend scanner.

capabilities.name: API and business-logic review
capabilities.scope: Guides scoped review of authentication, object/function authorization, abuse controls, races, injection, SSRF and data exposure.

capabilities.name: LLM and OAuth/OIDC review
capabilities.scope: Guides context-dependent review of prompt injection, cost abuse, tool permissions, OAuth state/PKCE and identity linking.

capabilities.name: Server code and data-layer review
capabilities.scope: Guides source and architecture review for dangerous sinks, authorization coverage, secret handling, tenant isolation, least privilege, backup and integrity.

capabilities.name: Supply-chain and detection review
capabilities.scope: Guides dependency, browser script, container, CI/CD, logging, alerting and incident-response review; existing release SBOM generation covers this repository only.

capabilities.name: AWS posture review
capabilities.scope: Guides contextual review of IAM, network, storage, logging and workload controls beyond the narrow read-only inventory helper.
